rewrites.//: SPA fallback. The negative lookahead is mandatory: without it an unregistered /api/* path returns index.html with status 200, and the client's res.json() throws a syntax error that hides the real problem. With it, Vercel's own 404 surfaces.

headers.//: Authenticated JSON must never be cached. /api/image is excluded so its handler can set its own private max-age just under the presign TTL; otherwise every thumbnail re-render costs a function invocation.
